description: Read recent reels from one public Instagram account, or inspect a specific reel URL. Get captions, dates, views, likes, comment counts, duration and music as JSON. Use it to compare short-video performance. Returns structured metadata rather than media files. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of reels wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

target.description: Instagram username, profile URL or direct reel URL; one target

name: instagram-reels
title: Instagram reels and engagement
